item.title: Hindsight AI Memory: How It Works and When to Use It
item.description:
Hindsight is an open-source agent memory system from Vectorize, released under the MIT license. It gives an AI agent three operations: retain (store and extract facts), recall (search memories) and reflect (reason over them to answer a question). It runs on PostgreSQL with pgvector, self-hosted or as the managed Hindsight Cloud.

This page is a neutral overview of Hindsight AI memory: what it stores, how retrieval works, what the benchmarks do and don’t show, its real limits, and when another tool is the better pick. Facts come from the GitHub README, the official docs and the paper, checked in October 2026.
